summary_1line: Bhishma recounts how King Vasu was cursed for siding with animal sacrifice, fell into the earth, but regained heaven through unwavering devotion to Narayana.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant white inhabitants of White Island run with folded hands toward a blinding light like a thousand suns, crying 'Namas!'
King Uparichara Vasu falls from the sky into a dark chasm in the earth as enraged rishis pronounce their curse.
Garuda dives into a deep pit in the earth, lifts King Vasu in his beak, and rises powerfully back into the open sky.
